whatToWatch.text: The defense showed up in Week 1 — just 10 points allowed and three sacks — and now they hit the road to prove it wasn't a one-week fluke in the desert.
Seattle rolls in 1-0 as a 3.5-point favorite with the total sitting at a stingy 41.5, so expect a grinder where every possession and every field position swing actually matters.

Injury report worth watching: one Seahawk is out and four are questionable, including Nick Emmanwori, Tory Horton and Ty Okada, while Arizona is down two with Kitan Crawford and Garrett Williams on the shelf.

newsBlurb.text: Drew Lock takes the reins in Arizona with Sam Darnold sidelined, and nobody's sure whether the injury costs Seattle one week or three. Lock looked steady in relief against New England, where the defense flipped last year's Week 1 script and closed out a 13-10 comeback instead of coughing it up late. Now Mike Macdonald's group finds out if that formula travels on the road — and Terrion Arnold's new deal gives the secondary another piece to lean on.
